generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 99 Violaceae: leaves alternate, rarely opposite, simple; stipules leafy or small; flowers regular or irregular, the lowest petal often larger and spurred; sepals 5; petals 5; stamens 5, ringed round the ovary; ovary free (superior), with 3 to 5 placentas; fruit a capsule that splits elastically, or a berry. The irregular flower is none of the named kinds (pea, two-lipped, orchid lip): zygomorphy other.

traits.rosette.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Violaceae: whether the leaves gather in rosettes (character 22), coded often a basal rosette, often no rosette. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 21 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
